correctness.rationale: Equation (24) of arXiv:2609.24392v1 gives the exact ambient norm. Deleting coordinates decreases both terms in that maximum, so every nonzero coordinate projection has norm exactly one. Each coordinate subspace is an intersection of kernels of canonical predual vectors, hence weak-* closed. If coordinate 1 is absent the restricted norm is exactly the \(\ell_1\) norm; if coordinate 1 is present with infinitely many tail coordinates, a tail permutation gives a surjective linear isometry with the ambient space. The codimension constructions delete exactly \(k\) coordinates. No finite computation is used.

value.rationale: The source's motivating issue is inheritance of strong predual uniqueness by weak-* closed codimension-one subspaces. The finding gives a natural complete classification of the entire infinite canonical coordinate lattice in the same explicit example. It shows that norm-one complementability and weak-* closedness alone are maximally nondiagnostic there: at every positive finite codimension both preservation and failure occur, and each behavior occurs continuum many times. This is a structural boundary statement rather than an arbitrary finite slice or a small numerical improvement.
